selection_policy: mean_r@1 descending, validation_loss ascending, earliest epoch
source: feat/omnirad-clip-pipeline (K8 windowed CLIP, gradient replay, timm-format towers); ran 2026-10-05 from the t3code-5f0dc525 worktree's then-uncommitted copy of that code via the gitignored chain.sh, translated here. The series mirror comes from paths.json (train_series_mirror).
purpose: CLIP + LoRA + K8 + 336 px: the factor-isolation LoRA recipe (r64/a128 on the last 6 blocks of both towers, lr 1e-4/1e-4/1e-3, batch 32, 20 epochs, seed 2026) on run 5's K8 336 inputs. Judged by frozen-tower LM MLP heads, whose configs set reload_tolerance 1e-3 because K8 features run under fp16 autocast. The OmniRad checkpoint also seeds configs/finetune/r4a-k8-omnirad-base-soft-336-from-clip-lora.json (scripts/finetune_supervised.py).
